before_conditions: The constant U16_PER_WORD equals 16, indicating that 16 fee rates can fit in a uint256.
The packFeeRates() function accepts up to 16 fee rates, corresponding to indices 0 through 15.
The getFeeAt() function contains a bounds check of index >= 15.
Fee rates have been packed such that the fee rate at index 15 exists in storage.
required_property: The getFeeAt() function should allow access to all valid fee rate indices, including index 15, so that any fee tier that can be packed can also be retrieved by components relying on the full set of 16 fee tiers.
bad_outcome: The fee rate at index 15 is inaccessible after packing, causing systems that expect 16 fee tiers to fail to access the highest tier, limiting fee tier systems to 15 tiers, and causing integration failures or reverts in components that use the maximum fee tier index.
